picks.editorial_note: CSIRO researchers used an independent machine-learning imaging technique to validate the iconic 2019 Event Horizon Telescope image of the M87 black hole, publishing in Nature — a rare case of AI providing rigorous cross-validation of a landmark astrophysics result.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built WorldParticle, a single deep-learning model that simulates wildly different physical phenomena — from sand to folding proteins — suggesting a path toward general-purpose physics simulation rather than bespoke models per domain.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon developed 'Workspace Models,' giving robots a new memory mechanism to recall past observations without expensive re-computation — a meaningful step toward more capable, efficient embodied AI.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: An MIT-led team secured up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use generative AI for discovering safer next-generation herbicide alternatives, a major federal bet on AI-driven chemistry with direct agricultural and health impact.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new DZM site in Munich, backed by up to €20 million in German federal funding, positions the university at the center of a national push to test AI-driven autonomous public transportation at scale.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team is combining satellite imaging, animal models, and AI to probe environmental contributions to Alzheimer's and dementia — a significant application of AI to a major public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research — spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and cybersecurity — signals a notable industry-academia push toward European technological sovereignty.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree to build a joint lab on embodied AI and robotics marks a substantial academia-industry collaboration in a fast-moving and strategically important field.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, operationalizes agentic AI for scientific workflows across the national lab system under the federal Genesis Mission — a concrete step in government AI policy for science.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab ties AI and high-performance computing directly to semiconductor manufacturing workforce needs, reflecting federal investment in AI-enabled industrial capacity.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training
